name: The Schoolhouse
description: Each teacher at the schoolhouse leads a different class in a different room. Work out who teaches what, and where.
clues: Either Annex goes with Geography or Geography goes with Frost.
Either Annex goes with History or Frost does not go with History (but not both) if and only if Piper goes with Library.
Exactly two of these are true: Boyd goes with Workshop; Frost goes with Geography; English goes with Iris.
Music goes with exactly two of Dunn, Pavilion, and Noah.
English, Geography, and Music go with Boyd, Hale, and Annex, in some order.
Either Piper goes with English or Annex goes with Dunn.
